correctness.rationale: The published total-graph decomposition reduces the problem to disjoint cliques and complete bipartite graphs. Exact matching classifications produce the polynomial, and lowest-degree/leading-coefficient analysis reconstructs q, s, and residue-characteristic parity. Brute checks on three actual rings agree.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete natural enumeration rather than a routine minimum-only parameter: it classifies all paired dominating sets, recovers q and |M| from the polynomial, detects residue-characteristic parity, and thereby determines the total graph within the finite local nonfield class.
